description:
SILENT WRONG (found by s540d while probing #4981, 2026-11-13; the same on the base 24988e35, so pre-existing -- NOT caused by #4981's cache): in a tr/// SEARCH or REPLACEMENT list an ESCAPED dash `\-` is a literal `-` in perl, never a range operator; PCL's expand-tr-chars (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp) reads `a\-c` as the range a-c and drops a leading `\-`.

Reproducer (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL, base and s540d tree identical):

    my $t = "a-b-c"; my $n = ($t =~ tr/a\-c/Z/); print "$n $t\n";
    my $u = "abc-"; my $m = ($u =~ tr/\-a/XY/); print "$m $u\n";
    my $v = "a-z"; my $k = ($v =~ tr/a\-z//); print "$k\n";

perl:              PCL:
    4 ZZbZZ            3 Z-Z-Z
    2 YbcX             1 Ybc-
    3                  2

Where: expand-tr-chars unescapes `\-` before (or without marking it for) the range pass.  Fix: an escaped character -- `\-` in particular -- is a literal in the range scan (perl's toke.c scan_const marks it so).  Guard: Pl/t/tr-01.t rows with the three lines above (perl's answers).  perl-tests/tr.t has no row for it (it passes 242 rows).  Probe file: s540d scratch/s540d/g/trdash.pl.


=== DONE (s543b) ===
Opus 5.5, 2026-11-16, WIP f41d5aaa.  MEASURED: the compiler (ExprToCL _expand_tr_escapes) decoded `\\` to a bare
backslash and `\x2d` to a bare dash and left `\-`; the runtime range scan (expand-tr-chars) knew no escapes -- confirmed.
FIX (Pl + cl): ONE convention for the list text -- escapes decoded, a backslash marks the next character LITERAL (a
decoded `-` or `\` is written back escaped); a range is two list characters around an UNESCAPED `-`, either end may be
escaped (`a-\z`, `\x41-\x43`, `\\-c`, `\--0`).  Probe scratch/s543b/p2/trdash.pl 32 lines: tree = perl (base 21 lines
differ); the breaking shapes (an escaped range START / END) = perl; s540d's per-op expansion cache (#4981) is not in
the way (probed by the resumed agent: the same ops run three times in a loop, cold and warm = perl).  Guard Pl/t/tr-01.t row 10 (fails on c5f618f2; the heredoc form re-checked in the final
inverse batch).  Companion op/tr.t 272/43 = 272/43 (same rows).  ir-spec "p-tr list text".


=== CLOSED at MAIN-READY-100 `64353611` (the reviewing session, 2026-11-21; s543b): a tr range is an UNescaped `-`; guard Pl/t/tr-01.t row 10.  Review probe (11 tr shapes incl. `\\-b`, `\x2d`, a string eval): = perl.  No baseline row keyed on it.
subject: SILENT WRONG: tr/// reads an escaped dash `\-` as a range (`tr/a\-c/Z/` = a..c; perl: a, -, c); a leading `\-` is dropped -- expand-tr-chars, pre-existing
